config.//connection: stringtype=unspecified lets PostgreSQL infer the column type from the value. Without it the driver sends depart_time and fetched_at as VARCHAR and Postgres refuses to put them in TIMESTAMPTZ columns.
config.//credentials: {{...}} markers are filled from .env by stream/deploy_connectors.py, so no real password is ever written to this file. The host stays literally 'postgres': Connect runs inside the Docker network, where POSTGRES_HOST (localhost) would not resolve.
config.//idempotency: Kafka delivers at least once, so the same observation WILL arrive twice. upsert on (offer_id, fetched_at) turns the second delivery into a no-op update instead of a duplicate row. Without this the model would train on price history that never happened.
